_comment: Local reference copy — synced from live n8n on 2026-06-11 (V1.1 pass). Live ID: chYfABnQdnPfiHQx. Phase 3 workflow. Runs daily at 9 AM ET (14:00 UTC). Sends Day 1/3/7 follow-up SMS to New/Contacted leads, then updates each lead via CRM Adapter. AI lead-scoring fields (Lead Score/Temperature/Urgency) removed in V1.1.
name: Follow-Up Sequence

parameters.jsCode:
// After Twilio fires, $json is the SMS response — trace back to the lead
const lead = $('Filter & Build Messages').item.json;
return [{ json: {
  leadId: lead.leadId,
  phone: lead.phone,
  source: lead.source,
  firstName: lead.firstName,
  lastName: lead.lastName,
  email: lead.email,
  address: lead.address,
  serviceNeeded: lead.serviceNeeded,
  status: lead.newStatus,
  followUpCount: lead.followUpCount,
  logChannel: lead.logChannel,
  logDirection: lead.logDirection,
  logHandler: lead.logHandler,
  logSummary: lead.logSummary,
  logNotes: lead.logNotes
}}];

parameters.content: This workflow runs every day at 9:00 AM ET, retrieves leads from Google Sheets, identifies which leads require follow-up, sends SMS follow-up messages to each eligible lead, updates the CRM with the communication details, and logs the activity.
